original_CPU.scope:
Execute complete unchanged sound-set field setter and parser instructions.

boundaries: open, key, token reader, sound lookup, calloc, malloc and close.

or original lexical tokenization. Error-path missing close calls are retained.

original_reference_v1_hydration_failure.root_cause: The v1 preparation cleared512bytes starting0x596cc0 for a19-entry packed field table. This overwrote the original END literal at0x596ea0,480bytes from table start. The439instruction bytes stayed unchanged, but parser control data was corrupted. The first public-C comparison detected the error; v1 is invalid as a parser behavior oracle and is retained as failure evidence.
original_reference_v1_hydration_failure.correction: The v2 generator clears only19*8=152declared table bytes and asserts the original END\0 bytes before and after every case. It re-executes the same unchanged original instructions and keeps all declared service boundaries. No original fixture, failed program, asset or source snapshot is overwritten.

real_file_initialization_failure.reason: The real-file test omitted initialization of the existing opaque file-handle bank. NewFileHandle panicked with call Init first. The same existing test pattern isolates files.byHandle, uses handles.InitHigh, closes owned files, restores the old registry and releases the fixture bank.
